title: Privileged observations enable rapid and reliable policy discovery directly in the physical world
abstract: arXiv:2512.08463v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how privileged information about a physical system affects the discovery of high-performing policies when training a reinforcement learning agent directly in the physical world. We let the agent control a cylinder in a tabletop water channel to maximize or minimize drag. The flow is chaotic and difficult to model or simulate accurately and good strategies are not obvious beforehand. Decades-old experimental studies provide recipes for simple, high-performance, periodic open-loop policies that increase drag by 26.6% +/- 0.7% and reduce it by 29.7% +/- 1.3%. With dense observations of the cylinder wake, the agent learns within tens of minutes policies that increase drag by 25.5% +/- 0.9% and reduce it by 32.4% +/- 1.6%. We record action trajectories during online policy execution and replay them open loop as fixed sequences; these replays increase drag by 23.2% +/- 2.2% and reduce it by 32.1% +/- 3.0%. translated_title: 特权观测使智能体能够直接在物理世界中快速可靠地发现策略
translated_abstract: 我们研究了关于物理系统的特权信息如何影响强化学习智能体直接在物理世界中训练时高性能策略的发现。我们让智能体控制桌面水槽中的一个圆柱体，以最大化或最小化其受到的阻力。该流动是混沌的，难以精确建模或仿真，且好的策略事先并不显而易见。数十年前的实验研究提供了简单、高性能、周期性开环策略的方案，可将阻力增加26.6% ± 0.7%，或将其减少29.7% ± 1.3%。借助对圆柱体尾流的密集观测，智能体在几十分钟内便学习到将阻力增加25.5% ± 0.9%或减少32.4% ± 1.6%的策略。我们记录了在线策略执行期间的动作轨迹，并将其作为固定序列进行开环重放；这些重放可将阻力增加23.2% ± 2.2%，或将其减少32.1% ± 3.0%。然而，当我们隐藏……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究表明，通过利用对物理系统的特权观测（如圆柱体尾流的密集测量），强化学习智能体可在数十分钟内直接在真实物理世界中快速发现超越数十年经典实验方案的高性能混沌流场控制策略。
en_tdlr: Privileged observations, such as dense measurements of a cylinder's wake, enable a reinforcement learning agent to rapidly discover high-performing control policies for chaotic fluid flows directly in the physical world within tens of minutes, surpassing decades-old experimental recipes.
